info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Petadoption Pets Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Pet Adoption Status API provides a comprehensive view of the status of pets available for adoption. Users can retrieve detailed information about various pets, including their current adoption status and availability. This API is designed for shelters, pet adoption agencies, and developers who are creating applications related to pet adoption. By integrating this API, consumers can enhance their platforms with up-to-date pet status information, facilitating a smoother adoption process.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to check the current status of all pets in the system. It helps in understanding the overall health and activity status of the pets available.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of pets. This body may include parameters that define the pet status to be fetched.

200.description: Request successfully retrieved the pets status.

ListPetadoptionPetsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on pet status. It is expected to be a string that contains relevant information regarding the status.
